en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a wide urban avenue lined with mid‑rise buildings featuring enclosed balconies, with a large plaza and park area on the left and busy pedestrian and car traffic on the right. Festive bunting hangs across the avenue. In the foreground on the right stands an ornate column topped with a clock. The lower border bears printed captions identifying the scene and photographer, with a scalloped edge typical of old postcards.
